product_name: COOHGRUBS Dried Mealworms for Birds, Non-GMO High Protein Chicken Treats & Poultry Feed, 2 lb Bag
short_description:
There’s a reason your chickens come running the second they hear the rustle of the bag — COOHGRUBS Dried Mealworms are the ultimate chicken treats they truly go wild for. Packed with 52% clean, natural protein and essential amino acids, these dried mealworms for chickens support stronger feathers, better egg production, and faster recovery during molt. But it’s not just your flock that benefits — our worms are also a favorite among wild birds, making them perfect as mealworms for wild birds. Whether you’re sprinkling them into daily chicken feed or hand-feeding as a reward, these non-GMO, additive-free grubs are irresistible to your whole backyard.
From hatchlings to layers, dried mealworms are a year-round powerhouse every bird owner should have on hand. Toss a handful in the coop to spark excitement, mix them into regular chicken feed for a protein boost, or scatter them on a platform feeder to attract bluebirds, robins, and other songbirds. These mealworms aren’t just snacks — they’re tools for enrichment, health, and connection. Watch your hens strut with glossy feathers, your eggs develop deeper yolks, and your yard come alive with winged visitors drawn to the same irresistible grubs. Whether you call them worms, mealworms, or grubs — COOHGRUBS delivers the taste, nutrition, and joy your feathered friends deserve.
ingredients: Dried Mealworms

Pearl Milling Company was a small mill in the bustling town of St. Joseph, Missouri. Using a pearl milling technique, they produced flour, cornmeal, and, beginning in 1889, the famous self-rising pancake mix that would go on to be known as Aunt Jemima. Our pancakes have been bringing smiles to the breakfast table ever since. Last June, PepsiCo and The Quaker Oats Company made a commitment to change the name and image of Aunt Jemima, recognizing that they do not reflect our core values. As part of its rebranding journey, Pearl Milling Company set out to fulfill two promises: to continue delivering the same great-tasting products families have enjoyed for over a century and to inspire moments that matter around the breakfast table and in communities. With a commitment to community impact, the brand developed P.E.A.R.L. Pledge (Prosperity, Empowerment, Access, Representation and Leadership) as a platform to help address societal barriers faced by Black women and girls. Recognizing the importance of Black women in the brand's history, P.E.A.R.L. Pledge will focus on providing funding to organizations helping to meet the significant needs facing Black women and girls today, such as gaps in food security and inadequate access to financial and educational resources.

Raw Sprouted Organic Almonds - Soaked in pink himalayan salt crystals and dehydrated at a low temperature to insure the nutritional integrity/improve the digestion of the almonds. Raw Red Maca (ma-kuh) - This root vegetable is native to the high Andes of Bolivia and Peru. It has an earthy, nutty taste with a slight hint of butterscotch. Maca has been used as a source of nourishment and healing for milleniums; and has long been used to increase stamina, boost libido, and combat fatigue, for many good reasons. The root is a superb adaptogen, as it enables the body to more easily adjust to and regulate stress factors imposed upon it.

Cinnamon - A small tree that grows in India, Sri Lanka, Indonesia, Brazil, Vietnam, and Egypt. In Ayurveda, cinnamon is used as a remedy for diabetes, indigestion, and colds.

Coconut Palm Sugar - Coconut palm sugar is made from the sweet nectar of the coconut tree flower blossoms, coconut palm sugar is a pure and simple low-glycerinic sweetener that provides the energy and mineral rich nutrition your body needs.

short_description: Our story begins in 1919. That?s when the world was introduced to what you now know as the Hostess CupCake. It?s perhaps the first and most significant moment in the history of snack cakes. Just ask your great grandpappy. He was there. Six years later, Continental Baking wanted to add a line of cakes to sell alongside a hot little item they were making called Wonder bread. This new line of sweet treats became known as Hostess. And a brand was born. Continental hit the sponge cake gold mine in 1930 when Jimmy Dewar invented Twinkies. At two for a nickel, popularity skyrocketed and it soon became Hostess? best-selling snack cake. Twinkies have since become an American icon. Half a billion are made each year. That?s a lot of creme filling! In the summer of 1995, Interstate Bakeries Corporation acquired Continental Baking Company. This made Interstate the largest wholesale baker of fresh delivered bread and cake in the United States. In 2009, Interstate changed its name to Hostess Brands, Inc., to better reflect our beloved brands. Fast forward to present day, and we?re continuing to turn everyday moments into small celebrations with a variety of new and classic treats like Ding Dongs, Ho Hos and Donettes, just to name a few. You can visit our products page to learn more about our delectable line of snack cake deliciousness. But please don?t ask us to pick a favorite.

product_name: Slofoodgroup 100% Pure Acai Berry Powder - 1 lb Acai for Drinks, Smoothies and Bowls
short_description: 1 lb freeze-dried açaí powder for drinks, smoothies and fruit bowls. SLOFOODGROUP's freeze-dried acai powder is made by freeze-drying the açaí berry, removing all moisture, and grinding into a fine powder to preserve the delicate flavor profile of this Amazonian fruit. What does açaí taste like? This fleshy little fruit is often described as having a similar flavor to both raspberries and pomegranates, but earthier, less sweet, and similar notes to those found in cacao. How to use freeze-dried açaí in your fruit bowls and smoothies? Freeze-dried açaí can be easily added to shakes, smoothies, and fruit bowls by simply mixing in water or adding alongside other ingredients during the blending process. We suggest starting with 1-2 tablespoons per eight-ounce serving and adjusting to fit your specific taste preferences.Often times, açaí is also sweetened with sugar, honey, or traditionally guarana, but we personally enjoy letting the other fruits naturally lend their sweetness to the final product rather than adding additional sugars. Ours is 100% real Açaí powder with no fillers. Try for yourself in fruit bowls, smoothies, and more.
ingredients: Açai Powder

I began with real ginger root - bright and earthy. Then lightly sweetened it with agave nectar, not loads of sugar or high fructose corn syrup.

short_description: Squeeze in the great taste of grapefruit with Squirt! Light, refreshing and full of natural citrus flavors, Squirt is also caffeine-free which makes it the perfect drink to enjoy any time of day. Created by Herb Bishop in Phoenix, Arizona in 1938 toward the end of the Great Depression, his idea was to make a soft drink that required less fruit and sugar than other sodas. When you’re looking for a drink to quench your thirst, the citrus soda always hits the spot. However, if you’re in the mood for a more adult drink for mixers and parties, try adding 1 part tequila to 3 parts Squirt and squeeze in lime for a Paloma, a popular drink in the United States as well as Mexico as far back as the 1950s. Reach for a Squirt when you’re looking for a thoroughly satisfying, refreshingly flavorful drink to quench your thirst with a burst of grapefruit and citrus!

short_description:
Sanpellegrino Sparkling Fruit Beverages

Since 1932, Sanpellegrino has crafted sparkling fruit beverages inspired by homemade Aranciata, a traditional Italian beverage made with fruit juice, carbonated water and real sugar. With this inspiration, we’ve created a variety of non-alcoholic citrus flavored sparkling beverages featuring fruit juice and authentic ingredients. Our sparkling fruit beverages have no artificial colors, flavors, sweeteners or preservatives. Sanpellegrino Ficodindia e Arancia is perfect on a hot summer afternoon, it is delicious on its own and can also be paired with fresh fruits and spices to create a unique cocktail experience.
ARANCIATA
The quality of the ingredients gives the iconic Aranciata its lively orange color, with fine bubbles that are pleasantly visible to the eye.
ARANCIATA ROSSA
Characterized by its red-orange color, Aranciata Rossa has a delicate scent that fills your nose with notes of ripe oranges.
CLEMENTINA
Sanpellegrino Clementina opens with a lovely bouquet of ripe clementine and orange on the nose which forms the most refreshing and rich taste in the mouth.
FICODINDIA E ARANCIA
Prickly pear – the spiky fruit that hangs like jewels on the cactus trees in the sunny Mediterranean coast, is the ingredient in Sanpellegrino Ficodindia e Arancia.
LIMONATA
With 16% juice from ripe lemons of southern Italy, Sanpellegrino Limonata is in a league of its own. Limonata has a soothing opal white colour that is punctuated with clean, crisp bubbles.
MELOGRANO E ARANCIA
Made with the delicious juices of oranges and pomegranate, Melograno e Arancia blooms with the flavor of gently squeezed orange juice paired with the exciting taste of pomegranate.
POMPELMO
Amazingly zesty and thirst-quenching, the gorgeous sun-ripened grapefruit from the citrus groves in the Mediterranean gives Sanpellegrino Pompelmo its unique characteristics.

short_description: Dr Pepper is known for its unique flavor. To take it up a notch, we added sweet blackberries to the original recipe of 23 signature flavors and Dr Pepper Blackberry was born. This delicious beverage, also available with Zero Sugar, is a sweet addition to our lineup of distinctive flavors including Dr Pepper Cherry, Dr Pepper and Cream Soda and Dr Pepper Strawberries and; Cream. It’s not your ordinary soda and it’s definitely not a cola. Established in 1885 in Waco, TX, Dr Pepper is the oldest major soft drink in the United States. It’s a refreshing favorite that’s always smooth and delicious at dinner, lunch or breakfast (we won’t judge you). Although you can enjoy the unique flavor all on its own, you can also pair it with food. Dr Pepper Blackberry is the perfect companion for everything from a full meal like pizza, burgers or rotisserie chicken to a quick snack like pastries, chocolates or your favorite candy. You can’t go wrong with a Dr Pepper Blackberry when you want to satisfy your sweet cravings.

Craving sweet tea without the kitchen drama? Cane Brew delivers the bold, Southern-style flavor you love—without boiling water, measuring sugar, or cleaning up sticky messes. Whether you're serving up iced tea on the porch, in the RV, or at a backyard BBQ, Cane Brew makes it easy to enjoy that rich, home-brewed taste anywhere, anytime.

In 1946, during the post-war boom of innovation and industry, Niles Foster set his sights on the market for convenient fruit based beverages. What captured his imagination was the idea of an orange drink, bubbly and bright, that would appeal to families seeking vitamins alongside refreshment. It needed to have a balance of tangy citrus and sweet flavors and possess the genuine nutrition of natural Vitamin C, the ingredient that earned the drink its name—Hi-C––because of its high content of Vitamin C compared to competing juices. The drink was immediately a hit in the south and in just a decade became a nationwide success. Over the years a variety of flavors have been added to the Hi-C portfolio. This product is: Naturally Decaffeinated, Liquid.
